_comment: Pterodactyl egg for the original SoF logger with web terminal
name: SoF Logger Web
author: sof-logger-web@example.com
description: Unmodified 2011 SoF logger exposed through an authenticated browser terminal. Upload package before install. Linux amd64 only.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
apt-get update
apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl
cd /mnt/server
if [ ! -f setup.sh ]; then echo "Upload and extract sof-logger-web.zip into server root first, then reinstall."; exit 1; fi
bash setup.sh

variables.name: SoF server IP
variables.description: IP address or hostname of your SoF game server. Reachable by UDP from this container.

variables.name: SoF game port
variables.description: The game server UDP port, not the logger web port.

variables.name: SoF RCON password
variables.description: Your existing game server RCON password. Keep private.

variables.name: Web password
variables.description: Separate web login password, at least 12 characters.

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Exact browser origin, e.g. https://logger.sof1.org. Required behind an HTTPS reverse proxy; no trailing path.
